instruction: Create a line chart showing Sales data over the weeks in a new sheet. Title the chart "Sales Trend Analysis".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a line chart (not bar/column) with title 'Sales Trend Analysis' in a new sheet. Similar difficulty to original but different chart type. Evaluator verifies: 1) Chart type is LineChartType, 2) Title matches exactly, 3) Chart is in a new sheet.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all three instruction requirements: chart type (LineChartType), chart title (Sales Trend Analysis), and new sheet location
Getter (get_vm_file) can successfully extract the Excel file after postconfig saves it with Ctrl+S
Metric function logic is sound: opens file with openpyxl, iterates through sheets excluding Sheet1, validates chart type and title
Partial credit scoring is reasonable: 0.3 for new sheet + 0.4 for correct type + 0.3 for correct title = 1.0 total
Edge case handling present with try-except block for file loading errors
Title extraction handles both rich text format and simple format appropriately
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor note: Chart type matching uses substring check (expected_type in chart_type_name), which means 'LineChartType' would match 'LineChartType3D'. This provides flexibility but could match unintended variants. Consider exact matching if strict validation needed.

Minor note: Title matching uses substring check (expected_title in actual_title), which means 'Sales Trend Analysis' would match 'Sales Trend Analysis 2024'. This is acceptable for this task but could lead to false positives in stricter scenarios.
Minor optimization: Logic breaks after finding first chart in new sheet. This assumes one chart per task, which is correct for this instruction.
